evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.945 Torr near the end of the ramp at 100 sccm Ar.
Growth began at 2.938 Torr; subsequent growth observations show a sustained pressure rise.
Pressure reached 3.208 Torr, approximately 9% above the start of growth despite unchanged temperature and Ar setpoints.
Measured temperature is 750.3 C against a 750.0 C setpoint.
Measured Ar flow is 100.1 sccm against a 100.0 sccm setpoint; flow has remained near setpoint during the pressure rise.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; pressure and Ar readings cannot verify atmospheric purity.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure profile or tolerance, independent pressure confirmation, exhaust conductance/pumping checks and leak or oxygen measurements to distinguish restriction from ingress or another pressure disturbance; sample characterization is not yet available.
